input.query: SELECT carrier, COUNT(*) AS n, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_shipped, MAX(delivered_ts) AS max_delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_delivered FROM shipments GROUP BY carrier ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delivered_n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_transit_days, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_shipped, MAX(shipped_ts) AS max_shipped FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'hct' AND shipped_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND shipped_ts < '2026-01-01'

final_answer.basis: 語意層無「準時送達」定義，shipments 表缺少承諾送達日（promised date），無法判斷是否準時；carrier 代碼 hct 疑為新竹物流，但語意層未確認對應。2025 年 hct 出貨 11,005 筆、已送達 9,778 筆、平均運輸 3.34 天，僅供參考，不能推算準時送達率。
